name: managing-privacy-breach-response
description: Evaluates healthcare privacy incidents and drafts the breach determination and notice plan for HIPAA covered entities, business associates, 42 CFR Part 2 programs and non-HIPAA health apps. Places discovery from the record (first workforce or agent knowledge, imputed vendor knowledge), tests the encryption safe harbor and the three breach exceptions, runs the four-factor low-probability risk assessment, treats ransomware as a presumed breach, counts affected individuals by state for HHS and media thresholds, and builds a clocks table giving each notice its own trigger and a script-computed deadline: individual, HHS, media, vendor, BAA, law enforcement delay, Part 2, FTC Health Breach Notification Rule and state attorney general notices. Use for HIPAA breach risk assessment, 60-day clock, misdirected PHI, stolen laptop, ransomware, vendor breach, Part 2 breach or state breach notice. Declines to backdate discovery or write a fixed no-breach conclusion. Drafts for privacy officer and counsel review.
